babyDevelopment: The fertilized egg begins dividing and preparing for implantation.
motherChanges: Hormonal changes begin, though symptoms are usually minimal.
tips: Consult your doctor if pregnancy is confirmed

babyDevelopment: Baby can hear sounds and is becoming more active.
motherChanges: You may begin feeling regular baby movements.

babyDevelopment: Baby's lungs continue developing and movement becomes stronger.
motherChanges: Back pain and leg cramps may increase.

babyDevelopment: Baby is fully developed and ready for birth.
motherChanges: Labor may begin at any time.
tips: Contact your doctor if contractions begin
